id: title:TueHaulund:pass the requested limit to collection recordings

review.posthog_relevance: Adds pagination support to the RecordingsQuery for collection playlists, allowing the backend to respect client-requested result limits and preventing excessive result sets.
review.reason: The change adds a `limit` parameter to the RecordingsQuery and includes a corresponding test asserting that the returned results are bounded by this limit. This represents a substantive, bounded improvement in query behavior and reliability.
review.uncertainty: The exact implementation of the limit enforcement and its performance characteristics are not fully demonstrated in the supplied hunk, though the behavior and test are clear.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a `limit` parameter to the RecordingsQuery when the playlist type is COLLECTION, while retaining the existing date range and session_ids. P1.F1.H1: `query = RecordingsQuery(session_ids=playlist_items, date_from="-1y", date_to=None, limit=limit)`
observations.posthog_connection: Allows session recording retrieval for collection playlists to respect a pagination or result-count limit supplied by the client, potentially preventing excessive result sets or enabling client-side pagination. P1.F2.H1: Tests that the returned results are bounded by the requested limit, retaining only the newest sessions up to that count.

observations.behavior: Adds a test asserting that the recordings returned for a collection playlist respect the requested `limit` parameter. P1.F2.H1: `assert {x["id"] for x in response.json()["results"]} == set(sessions_newest_first[:2])`
observations.code_quote: assert {x["id"] for x in response.json()["results"]} == set(sessions_newest_first[:2])
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression protection and documentation of expected behavior for the limit parameter, ensuring that collection playlist recordings do not return more results than requested.
